questions.question_text: Which storage account kind supports Object Replication?
questions.explanation: Object Replication is only available with the StorageV2 (general purpose v2) account kind.

questions.question_text: Which redundancy option stores copies of data in multiple geographic regions?
questions.explanation: GRS replicates data to a secondary region, providing protection against regional outages.

questions.question_text: What is the default encryption setting for an Azure Storage account?
questions.explanation: Azure Storage encrypts data at rest by default using Microsoft‑managed keys.

questions.question_text: Which Azure tool is primarily used to view and manage storage account metrics and blobs?
questions.explanation: Storage Explorer is a standalone client that lets you browse, edit, and monitor storage accounts.

questions.question_text: Which PowerShell cmdlet enables soft delete on a storage account?
questions.explanation: The Enable-AzStorageAccountSoftDelete cmdlet turns on soft delete for the specified storage account.

questions.question_text: Which statement about storage account keys is true?

options.label: A
options.text: Keys are rotated automatically every 30 days.

options.label: B
options.text: Keys are used for authentication and can be regenerated.

options.label: C
options.text: Keys are not required when using Azure AD authentication.

options.label: D
options.text: Keys are only used for read access.

questions.explanation: Storage account keys are credentials used for authentication and can be regenerated at any time.

questions.question_text: When configuring a storage account for static website hosting, which setting must be enabled?
questions.explanation: The static website feature must be turned on in the account settings to host a website.

questions.question_text: Which replication type copies data asynchronously to a secondary region and is recommended for disaster recovery?
questions.explanation: GRS (Geo‑Redundant Storage) asynchronously replicates data to a secondary region, suitable for DR scenarios.

questions.question_text: To configure encryption with customer‑managed keys, which Azure resource must be linked to the storage account?
questions.explanation: Customer‑managed keys are stored in Azure Key Vault and must be linked to the storage account for encryption.

questions.question_text: Which Azure CLI command creates a storage account named 'mystg' with a Standard_LRS SKU in resource group 'rg'?

options.label: A
options.text: az storage account create --name mystg --resource-group rg --sku Standard_LRS

options.label: B
options.text: az storage account create --name mystg --sku Standard_LRS

options.label: C
options.text: az storage account create --name mystg --resource-group rg --sku Standard_GRS

options.label: D
options.text: az storage account create --name mystg --sku StorageV2

questions.explanation: The command in option A specifies the account name, resource group, and the Standard_LRS SKU.
